Markets.title: US Markets Today: US stocks end lower as Alphabet revenue miss revives AI capex jitters
Markets.summary: US stocks closed lower after Alphabet's revenue miss sparked concerns about artificial intelligence spending. The Nasdaq Composite suffered the steepest decline, dropping 1.36 percent.

Markets.title: Cash takes centre stage as investors rethink AI spending boom
Markets.summary: Investors are prioritizing technology companies' cash generation to fund artificial intelligence investments. While Microsoft and Oracle are gaining positive attention for their financial strength, Alphabet faces concerns because its AI spending has surpassed its operating cash flow.

Markets.title: Alphabet’s AI risks deepen as filing reveals $98 billion in commitments beyond the $1 trillion spending
Markets.summary: Alphabet disclosed nearly $98.5 billion in contingent financial commitments, such as data center leases and chip system repurchases, beyond its $1 trillion AI spending. These massive investments and growing partnership backlogs have raised concerns about the sustainability of Google Cloud's expansion.

Markets.title: Sagility block deal: Promoter Sagility BV likely to sell 12% stake for Rs 2,377 crore
Markets.summary: Sagility promoter Sagility B.V. plans to sell a 12% stake in the healthcare IT services firm for Rs 2,377 crore through a block deal. This move follows the company's Q2 FY27 report showing 22.5% revenue growth and 8.1% adjusted profit growth.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian equities rallied over 1% on Thursday, with the Sensex gaining 905 points and the Nifty rising 238 points. The market surge added nearly ₹5 lakh crore in value, driven by the Federal Reserve holding interest rates steady, easing crude prices, and stronger institutional buying.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Eternal among 2 stocks to buy for Friday for healthy returns

Data & Insights.summary: The Finance Ministry reports that recent GST reforms will help the economy maintain a high-growth trajectory in fiscal year 2027. However, the department of economic affairs cautions that elevated global oil prices and inflation require ongoing vigilance.

Data & Insights.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang names 3 countries leading in tech, manufacturing: Which are they? Does India make the list?
Data & Insights.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang identified the United States, China, and Taiwan as the world's leading nations in manufacturing and advanced technology. India was excluded from this list, with Huang noting China's strength stems from combining industrial production with computer science.

Data & Insights.title: India’s public debt ratio to fall to 75.1% of GDP by FY32, only major emerging economy set for a decline: RBI DG
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta stated that India's public debt ratio is projected to drop from 84.3% of GDP in FY26 to 75.1% by FY32. India is the only emerging market economy with a GDP over $1 trillion expected to reduce its public debt during this period.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial output growth a tad slower at 6.7% in September, expansion led by manufacturing, electricity generation
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September from 8% in August. The expansion was primarily driven by strong performances in manufacturing and electricity generation, which offset a decline in mining.

Data & Insights.title: Cabinet approves PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana for 2026-31 with  ₹7,395 crore outlay to strengthen Panchayat governance
Data & Insights.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana with an outlay of ₹7,395.55 crore for the 2026-31 period. The scheme aims to strengthen governance across more than 2.55 lakh Panchayats, benefiting approximately 32 lakh elected representatives and functionaries.

Data & Insights.title: India's industrial output growth slows to 6.7% in September as manufacturing, consumer durables lose momentum
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September, missing the 7.3% market expectation as manufacturing and electricity moderated and mining contracted 6.2%. Despite the monthly slowdown, industrial production grew 6.8% during the April-September period, up from 4.4% the previous year.

India.title: Jamia Finally Sets Dates For Restoring Students' Union, Protest Ends With 'Victory' Celebrations
